name: Raycast
summary: Dark command-center style with near-black surfaces, Inter typography, neutral filled CTAs, restrained coral brand moments, glass navigation, product mockups, and tactile keyboard-key inset cards.

typography.mono_fallback: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Courier, monospace

layout.composition: full-bleed dark hero followed by contained dark sections and feature grids

do: Use #040506 as the only page background.
Use Mist filled buttons with Iron text for primary actions.
Reserve coral for brand, hero, badge, and tiny selected-state moments.
Use Inter 56px regular for the hero headline.
Use the key-shadow inset stack on elevated cards.
Render technical metadata in Geist Mono.
dont: Do not use chromatic CTA buttons.
Do not use coral for body text, general links, or broad icon accents.
Do not add conventional drop shadows to cards.
Do not introduce light theme sections.
Do not mix many accent colors in one surface.
Do not use SF Pro Text for body copy.
Do not break the 8px spacing grid.
